statement: A CDC-propagated system-table row that a joiner missed converges within one steady-state cooldown instead of never: the steady-state catch-up driver (MembershipPublicationCoordinatorReconcile, which already pulls control_plane_publications forward on the non-write-leader deferral tick) gains a sibling sweep over every OTHER CDC-propagated table (services included) behind its own 30000 ms cooldown, riding the same tick with the CL-014 catch-up's default local-first/owner-fallback read policy and never the publications leader pin, read-only and fail-soft. GCP run 2026-08-30T15-30-04: a services row for the result-table partition tbl-d915-p1 was inserted 31 seconds after joiner ef6a6eec's one-shot join-time hydration, the leader's follow-up CDC UPDATE found no local row ('No row found for CDC update') with no repairing event, and steady-state hydration re-read only publications, so that joiner's routing snapshot held canonicalLeaderServiceCount 0 for ten minutes and every distributed write it coordinated to the partition timed out (the merged top-10 was never written and the demo failed after 600 seconds). The publications sweep keeps its cooldown, single-table scope and leader-pinned token; leader election, readiness rules, budgets, the 60-second certification window and the 120-second barrier are unchanged. Proven deterministically through the real defer branch, the real sibling sweep and the real CL-014 hydrate: red on HEAD, green after.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.

The steady-state catch-up driver (MembershipPublicationCoordinatorReconcile) remains the single owner of the deferral-tick sweeps and reuses the existing CL-014 hydrate; routing snapshots, the parallel-reduce loop and the partition CDC layer are consumers and re-derive nothing.

The publications sweep keeps its 5000 ms cooldown, its exact single-table scope and its owner-RPC leader-pinned authority token; the sibling sweep never applies that pin and uses the catch-up default local-first/owner-fallback policy.
The sibling sweep rides only the existing deferral tick behind its own 30000 ms cooldown (no new timer, sleep or cadence), never throws, and reads only; no write, promotion or trim.

Leader election, readiness rules, budgets, the 60-second GCP certification window and the 120-second barrier are unchanged; nothing derives cluster-ACTIVE or READY from nodes.status, publication counts or coverage.

Proof is a deterministic witness through the real defer branch, the real sibling sweep and the real CL-014 hydrate reproducing GCP run 2026-08-30T15-30-04 (a services row landing after the one-shot hydration with its fan-out dropped), red on HEAD and green after, with the two publications-scoped controls that must stay green; no GCP run is part of the proof.
